# Customer Session Functions

Defines three callable operations for establishing a customer payment session, requesting funding and recording funding confirmation. Each takes an `input` object and uses state in the document where it executes, including a nested instruction’s own document.

`call/channel` identifies the caller’s channel; `timestamp` supplies the current time value. Both `provideSession` and `confirmFunding` require `sourceMode` to equal `workflow` and `call/channel` to match `/paymentTerms/guarantorChannel`; otherwise they reject with `CUSTOMER_SESSION_OPERATOR_REQUIRED`. No default for `sourceMode` is established here.

## `provideSession`

Requires `/payment/accepted` to be exactly `true` (`ACCEPT_INSTRUCTION_FIRST`). `input.sessionId` must be nonempty text (`SESSION_ID_REQUIRED`); omission is treated as an empty string.

If `/customerSession/id` is not an empty string, a different ID rejects with `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`, while the same ID returns `duplicate` without changing the session or validating a new expiry.

For a new session, `input.expiresAt` must be an integer strictly greater than `timestamp` (`CUSTOMER_SESSION_EXPIRY_INVALID`). Its default is `timestamp` plus `900000000`; the time unit is not established by the supplied definition.

The operation stores the ID and expiry at `/customerSession/id` and `/customerSession/expiresAt`. It adds `/paymentAction` with `id` equal to the session ID, `kind` equal to `customer-funding`, and `party` taken from `/paymentTerms/payerChannel`. This action describes the responsible party and an opaque, nonsecret ID; it grants no authority. It emits `Customer Payment Session Ready` with `sessionId` and returns `acceptedNew`.

## `requestFunding`

Requires `call/channel` to match `/paymentTerms/payerChannel` (`CUSTOMER_PAYER_REQUIRED`). The stored session ID must not be empty and must match `input.sessionId`, whose omission defaults to an empty string (`SESSION_ID_MISMATCH`). A `timestamp` at or beyond `/customerSession/expiresAt` rejects with `CUSTOMER_SESSION_EXPIRED`.

After those checks, `/customerSession/requested` equal to `true` returns `duplicate`. Otherwise, `/payment/closed` equal to `true` rejects with `CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_CLOSED`. Thus an expired retry rejects, while an already-requested, unexpired retry returns `duplicate` even if payment is closed.

A new request sets `/customerSession/requested` to `true`, emits `Customer Funding Requested`, and returns `acceptedNew`. The event carries `sessionId`, `amountMinor` from `/paymentTerms/amountMinor` in the minor units of the currency identified by `/paymentTerms/currency`, and that `currency`. This records a request, not secured funds or completed payment.

## `confirmFunding`

Requires the stored session ID to be nonempty and match `input.sessionId`, with omission treated as an empty string (`SESSION_ID_MISMATCH`). If `/customerSession/funded` is already exactly `true`, it returns `duplicate`. Otherwise it sets that field to `true`, removes `/paymentAction`, emits `Customer Funding Confirmed` with `sessionId`, and returns `acceptedNew`.

`requested` and `funded` distinguish a recorded funding request from an operator-confirmed funding state. Their initial values are not defined here; absent values do not establish false. An empty session ID is explicitly treated as no session, but absence is not defined as equivalent.

Confirmation does not check expiry, payment acceptance, closure or a prior funding request. It records the authorized operator’s confirmation; these functions do not independently verify external fund movement or establish completion of the overall payment.
